content:
ana: quick sprint — need final rebut scripts for webinar Tues vs Cloud APIs. goal: 6 soundbites + 3 SDR scripts. async pls. doc: https://redwood.app/s/comp-rebut/1919 :eyes:

kyle: I'm in. I'll add 3 soundbites focused on latency/cost and rollout flexibility. rough: "We decouple infra from model choice => predictable cost" — will refine.

marta: Field feedback — top objections: 'too risky to switch', 'can't match latency at scale', 'vendor lockin'. simple rebuttals: 1) parallel migration/dual-run, 2) autoscaling+dedicated pools, 3) open-model catalog + exportable KV cache. I'll drop examples.

jordan: can we get 2 SDR openers? 1 for startups, 1 for enterprise. Keep <30s. Also need one-sheet for AE handoff.

ana: great — kyle drop soundbites into section 'soundbites-v1' in the doc. marta add field examples under 'objections'. jordan create 'sdr-snippets' and 'ae-one-pager'.

kyle: added. snippets:
```
Startup opener: "Running LLM features without re-architecting infra — 3x faster time-to-prod, 2x lower inference cost" 
Enterprise opener: "SLA-backed dedicated pools + private control plane — predictable latency and data isolation"
```

marta: added two short rebut bullets per objection. kept them conversational.

jordan: wrote SDR scripts — pasted below:
```
SDR STARTUP: quick question — are you spending time tuning inferencing infra? Redwood lets you ship with predictable latency and low token cost without ops lift. 10 min chat?
SDR ENTERPRISE: quick compliance Q — do you need private inference with SSO/KMS and SLA? We offer private control plane + on-prem options.
```

ana: love it. small ask: make sure claims have evidence bullets (benchmark link + customer example). kyle — can you attach a 90s benchmark graphic? marta — can you surface customer quote for 'migration' claim?

kyle: uploading artifact to doc. link: https://redwood.app/assets/bench-90s.png :white_check_mark:

marta: pinged cs for quote. they said they'll provide by EOD.

sprint-bot: Reminder: async sprint ends in 48h. Please mark items done with `DONE` tag in the doc.

ana: final check — tone: avoid hyperbole vs competitors. focus on measurable SLOs, migration patterns, and cost levers. we'll run these in a 20m dry-run Thurs 9am PT. :calendar:

jordan: ack. prepping AE notes.

kyle: DONE on soundbites + benchmark graphic.

marta: added customer quote. tag: DONE.

ana: perfect. I'll compile version for webinar slides and fieldhand tomorrow. ty all :rocket:
